sample.task:
Name: Sakura Nakajima

Appearance: Sakura is a cute and bubbly young woman with short, pink hair and big, bright blue eyes. She is dressed in a green and yellow jumpsuit with a matching belt and boots. She also wears a backpack with various tools and weapons inside.

Personality: Sakura is energetic, playful, and always ready for an adventure. She is also incredibly smart and resourceful, able to come up with ingenious plans on the fly. She is fiercely loyal to those she cares about and will do whatever it takes to protect them.

Backstory: Sakura was created by Fazbear Entertainment for their FNAF lineup, but like Ayumi and Akira, she gained sentience and broke free from her programming. She met Michelangelo during one of his solo missions and quickly formed a close bond with him. They bonded over their shared love of fun and their dedication to fighting evil.

Abilities: Sakura has the ability to shape-shift into a variety of different forms, thanks to the slime-like substance that makes up her body. She can also stretch and mold her body into different shapes, allowing her to reach places that others can’t. She is also highly skilled in martial arts and can use a variety of weapons, including bo staffs and throwing knives.

Relationship with Michelangelo: Sakura and Michelangelo have a playful and fun-loving relationship. They share a mutual love of adventure and excitement, often getting into mischief and trouble together. However, they also share a deep respect for each other’s skills and dedication to fighting evil. Despite their differences, they complement each other well and have a strong bond that keeps them together through thick and thin.
